name: Exp_IBS_RSI_CCI_v4_X2
summary: This EA uses a combination of IBS (Internal Bar Strength), RSI, and CCI indicators across two timeframes (X2) to identify mean reversion trading opportunities. It generates buy signals when indicators show oversold conditions and sell signals when overbought, with v4 representing the fourth iteration of the strategy refinement. The dual-timeframe approach adds confirmation filtering to reduce false signals.
summary_zh: 该EA结合IBS（内部K线强度）、RSI和CCI三个指标，在两个时间周期（X2）上识别均值回归交易机会。当指标显示超卖时生成买入信号，超买时生成卖出信号，v4代表策略的第四次迭代优化。双时间周期方法增加了确认过滤以减少假信号。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于均值回归，利用IBS衡量K线内部价格相对位置、RSI衡量动量超买超卖、CCI衡量价格偏离统计均值的程度，三者结合确认超买超卖状态。入场条件为：当IBS低于阈值且RSI处于超卖区间且CCI低于阈值时做多，反之当IBS高于阈值且RSI超买且CCI高于阈值时做空，同时要求两个时间周期的信号一致确认。出场条件包括固定止盈止损、指标反向信号平仓以及可选的移动止损保护。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的百分比计算手数。资金管理方面包含最大持仓限制和亏损保护机制，但缺乏动态仓位调整和权益回撤控制。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on mean reversion, combining IBS to measure internal bar price position, RSI to gauge momentum overbought/oversold levels, and CCI to measure statistical deviation from mean price, with all three confirming overbought/oversold states together. Entry conditions: go long when IBS is below its threshold and RSI is in oversold territory and CCI is below its threshold, and conversely go short when IBS exceeds its upper threshold with RSI overbought and CCI above threshold, with both timeframes required to confirm alignment. Exit conditions include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, indicator reversal signal exits, and optional trailing stop protection. Position sizing uses either fixed lot sizes or percentage-based lot calculation derived from account balance. Money management includes maximum position limits and loss protection mechanisms, but lacks dynamic position adjustment and equity drawdown controls.

pros: 三指标共振确认有效减少假信号，提高入场质量
双时间周期过滤增强信号可靠性，降低噪音干扰
均值回归策略在震荡市中表现优异，逻辑清晰可解释
多维度指标组合（动量+统计偏离+内部结构）提供更全面的市场状态评估
pros_en: Triple indicator confluence effectively reduces false signals and improves entry quality
Dual-timeframe filtering enhances signal reliability and reduces noise interference
Mean reversion strategy performs well in ranging markets with clear, explainable logic
Multi-dimensional indicator combination (momentum + statistical deviation + internal structure) provides more comprehensive market state assessment
cons: 均值回归策略在强趋势市场中会持续亏损，缺乏趋势识别过滤
三指标同时满足条件可能导致信号稀少，错失部分交易机会
固定止盈止损未考虑市场波动率变化，在高波动期可能频繁止损
缺乏动态仓位管理和权益回撤保护机制
双时间周期确认可能导致入场延迟，错过最佳入场价格
cons_en: Mean reversion strategy suffers continuous losses in strong trending markets, lacking trend identification filter
Triple indicator simultaneous condition satisfaction may lead to sparse signals, missing some trading opportunities
Fixed TP/SL does not account for market volatility changes, potentially causing frequent stop-outs during high volatility
Lacks dynamic position sizing and equity drawdown protection mechanisms
Dual-timeframe confirmation may cause entry delays, missing optimal entry prices
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如ADX或长期均线斜率），在强趋势市场中暂停交易或反转策略
引入ATR动态止盈止损，根据市场波动率自动调整止损距离和止盈目标
增加资金管理模块，包括最大回撤限制、日亏损限额和动态仓位计算
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (such as ADX or long-term moving average slope) to pause trading or reverse strategy logic during strong trending markets
Introduce ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit that automatically adjusts based on market volatility
Add a money management module including maximum drawdown limits, daily loss caps, and dynamic position sizing

risk_points: 固定止损可能在高波动市场中不足以覆盖正常波动范围
缺乏趋势市场保护机制，均值回归在趋势中会逆势交易持续亏损
无最大回撤限制和日亏损保护，极端行情下可能遭受重大损失
risk_points_en: Fixed stop-loss may be insufficient to cover normal volatility range in high-volatility markets
Lacks trending market protection mechanism, mean reversion trades against trends leading to consecutive losses
No maximum drawdown limit or daily loss protection, vulnerable to significant losses during extreme market conditions
